argument_text: Art is what makes him do a little — a pot or two — who cannot do all. Knowing is what makes him know a little — the pot before him, not the thing far away. Passion is the clinging to things — "being incomplete and apart, may this serve me; may I grow; may I never cease" — in that shape. Time is what cuts the sequence of things as they shine and unshine — "I knew, I know, I will know; I did, I do, I will do" — measuring even things in the shape of knowing and doing, it cuts them off: past and the rest. Necessity is what holds him to "this is mine to do, that is not mine to do" — manifold shapes of must, fixed fruit from fixed cause among them. These five, by veiling His own form, are called the sheath — other than His form, yet not other, lying over the nature of full consciousness like a cover. The root-cause of the levels from the great down to earth is nature — goodness, passion, and darkness in equipoise: pleasure, pain, and delusion by make, shining, doing, and holding by nature — an undivided poise where part and counterpoint cannot be told apart. What decides — "this is such" — holding the mirror up to passing thoughts, fit by clarity to catch reflections, is intellect. What means "mine, not mine" in pride is ego. What means resolve is mind. These three are the inner organ — grasping inner things like pleasure, made of the strands in part-and-counterpoint, and the cause of the sense-and-gross heap to come. The means of grasping sounds, touches, forms, tastes, smells in order are ear, skin, eye, tongue, nose — the five knowing senses. The means of speaking, taking, moving, voiding, and blissful action in order are voice, hands, feet, evacuation, generation — the five doing senses. Sounds, touches, forms, tastes, smells in their common shape — that and nothing more, with no inner distinctions — are the five subtles. Ether gives room; air keeps alive; fire burns and cooks; water refreshes and flows; earth upholds.
